system.description:
As an Action, you release pent up heat, creating a hazy wave of heat that creates optical illusion making it hard to adequately select a target. All creatures in a 30-Foot Cone originating from you must make a Wisdom saving throw, gaining 2 ranks of Dazzled on a failure.

Creatures with ranks of Immolation that make this saving throw, do so suffering a -1 penalty to their saving throws for each rank of Immolation it has.
